title: Video Orchestrator Content Brief (VO-2F)
description: Input specification for one future video. Defines source materials, constraints, and platform targets. Schema-only in VO-2F; no media rendering, no platform APIs, no upload.

schema_version.description: Schema version for this brief format.

brief_id.description: Local symbolic identifier for this content brief. Never a credential, token, or secret.

project_id.description: References project_id from project distribution plan.

title.description: Human-readable working title for this content.

objective.description: Short purpose statement: what this video is meant to accomplish.

content_type.description: Content category: short-form (TikTok, Reels), long-form (YouTube), carousel (multi-slide), text_post (social), mixed.

source_materials.description: Array of source material references. Can be empty for outline-only briefs.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when brief was created.

material_id.description: Local identifier for this material reference.

local_path.description: Optional relative path to material (e.g., 'drafts/script-001.md'). Must be relative, not absolute, not a URL. Used for reference only; not read by VO-2F.

summary.description: Optional brief description of this material. No personal data, no secrets.

max_duration_seconds.description: Optional maximum duration in seconds (e.g., TikTok 10min, YouTube 12hr).

aspect_ratios.description: Required aspect ratios for this content.

captions_required.description: Whether captions are required (most platforms now require).

safe_zone_profile.description: Optional safe zone profile for safe area guidance.

prohibited_claims.description: Optional list of claims/statements to avoid.

compliance_notes.description: Optional compliance/legal notes (e.g., 'disclose affiliate links', 'include health disclaimer').
